key_insight: A physics-informed neural network learns the asymptotic phase of limit-cycle oscillators across their basin of attraction, supporting phase-based control.
engineering_relevance: The learned phase and its gradient enable fast phase-locking feedback control, including entrainment with strong inputs.
method: Learn the phase function from a mathematical oscillator model using a PINN.
Combine three loss types to enforce the phase PDE and the adjoint equation for its gradient.
Use automatic differentiation to obtain phase gradients for feedback control.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports validation on three types of limit-cycle oscillators and demonstrations of fast, global phase-locking control.
watch_item: Accuracy across the full basin and under strong inputs should be checked; the abstract provides no quantitative error or runtime benchmarks.
paper_title: Physics-informed neural network for model-based global computation of the asymptotic phase of limit-cycle oscillators
